purpose: Guard test cleanup fails intermittently with ENOTEMPTY (rmdir of the fixture root) even after its 10 retries. Seen on four unrelated PRs (#5614, #5047, #5136, #5140) at different tests of scripts/p7-autopilot-guard.test.mjs; later heads pass. Cause: the CI runner uses git 2.55, where maintenance.autoDetach defaults to true, so every `git commit` in a fixture hands `git maintenance run --auto` to a detached background process that can still be writing under .git when the test body returns and t.after removes the directory. Measured locally with GIT_TRACE: a default repository's `git commit` spawns `maintenance run --auto` (2 trace hits); with maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0 it spawns none.
requiredInvariants: No assertion, test case, expected output, retry count or guard behaviour changes. The only change is repository-local git configuration applied right after each fixture `git init`.

The configuration is set in the shared git() helper, which is the only place fixtures initialise repositories (five `git init` sites, all through it), and it is repository-local, so it also applies to the git commands the guard script runs inside the fixture.
scripts/p7-autopilot-guard.sh and every workflow stay byte-identical to main. No test is skipped, disabled, quarantined or retried more.
acceptance: GIT_TRACE check: `git commit` in a default repository spawns `git maintenance run --auto`; after maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0 it spawns nothing.
